producer_report.summary: Wrote docs/design/async-drain.md. It has the measured baseline (42-minute median, 35 of 61 landed), the five points in sections 3 to 7, a target of about 20 minutes per landed job (estimate) with a stage-by-stage calculation, a disk budget of about 9 GB per in-flight job (estimate), a failure table, alternatives, and ten ordered build jobs with dependencies. Added D145 (proposed) to docs/decisions.md and a CHANGELOG entry. No source changes; the xtask policy and spec tests pass.

checks_run.note: 12 passed (reads tracked files only; new file rechecked with a word search)

criteria_check.criterion: docs/design/async-drain.md has a section for each of the five points: read-ahead and hard-job planning; early producer start in its own worktree bounded by disk and shared build cache; one ordered landing queue with rebase-or-return-to-producer; CI waits and self-rebuild as background awaits; ordering of records commits with several jobs in flight.
criteria_check.evidence: Sections 3 to 7 of the new design cover the five points in order.

criteria_check.criterion: The design states the measured baseline (median 42 minutes per landed job: producer 15, checks 13 to 15, landing about 6 to 8, verifier 2.3, reading and planning up to 5; 35 of 61 jobs landed over 2026-10-27 to 29) and a target in minutes per landed job with a stage-by-stage calculation; any figure not measured is labeled an estimate.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 1 gives the baseline table and 35 of 61; section 8 calculates about 20 minutes per landed job from the check slot, rebase recheck, contention and idle gaps, each labeled estimate.

criteria_check.criterion: The design gives a disk budget per in-flight job (with the arithmetic and the in-flight limit it implies), and failure and conflict handling: rebase conflict returns to the producer, a failed CI, a failed self-rebuild, a crash mid-flight, and a thrash stop.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 9: 0.1+5.0+0.3+3.3 = 8.7, about 9 GB, limit floor((free-20)/9) with worked cases; section 10 table has a row for each named case.

criteria_check.criterion: The design lists alternatives considered, and an ordered list of build jobs, each sized for one producer run, with dependencies between them stated.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 11 lists alternatives a to h; section 12 lists ten jobs, each with a Depends on line.

criteria_check.evidence: D145 appended with heading '(proposed)', Case/Decision/Alternatives/Tradeoff/Reversal cost/Provenance, and a link to design/async-drain.md.

open_issues: The 20-minute target and the 9 GB disk budget are estimates; build job 4 and job 10 are meant to measure them.
I did not run the athena-cli backtest test that compares decisions.md with decision-links.toml; the new entry avoids the parsed phrases and sits after every linked line.
mistakes: First changelog edit failed because the anchor was not unique; retried with more context.
learnings: docs/decision-links.toml holds line numbers of supersession phrases in decisions.md; appending an entry at the end shifts none, and the entry must avoid the phrases the parse looks for (supersede, amend).
desires: A tail or Read-only way to confirm the decision-links parse of new text without running the full athena-cli tests.
